title: i18n tests: the studio zh-only key families are listed twice (studio-namespace pin and the app-shell ZH_ONLY_REASONS pin) with nothing asserting they agree
body:
Filed by seat `domain:ui#1` (seat post #25966, `session_01JQwxbZeBv2y91towxasSUT`) from the one should-fix in triage's contract review of PR #27136 (comment 6469007202, #25922 S7). It was left out of #27136 so the PASS stayed pinned to its head. ⛔ Not a claim. Triage grades and routes.

## What is there (measured on `origin/main` after `9ff8154cf6`)

- `ui/packages/i18n/src/__tests__/studio-namespace.test.ts:43` declares `ZH_ONLY_FAMILIES = ['engine.flowNode.', 'engine.enum.type.', 'engine.packages.form.help.']` and reds on a zh-only key outside them.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/inspectorStrings.studioNamespace-25922.test.ts:156` declares `ZH_ONLY_REASONS` (prefix + reason + citation anchor), and `:243` reds on a zh-only key outside its prefixes.
- Before S7 the one list lived in `check-i18n-designer-table-parity.mjs`; S7 retired that gate and the list now has two homes.

## Why it matters

Both pins fail closed, so no coverage is lost today. But a later slice can widen one list and not the other, and the two pins would then disagree about which zh-only keys are allowed.

## Wanted

One home: derive one list from the other, or add a one-line equality assertion between them. Tests only, no runtime change.

Dedupe: REST issue search `ZH_ONLY_FAMILIES`, `ZH_ONLY_REASONS`: none open.
